sources.title: translategemma-4b-it: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview translategemma-4b-it is a lightweight translation model developed by google that handles text and image-based translation across 55 languages. Built on the Gemma 3 architecture, this 4-billion-parameter model operates with a 2K-token context window and processes images normalized to 896x896 resolution (encoded to 256 tokens each). The model was fine-tuned from Gemma 3 checkpoints ...

sources.title: olive-recipes/google-translategemma-4b-it/builtin at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: Export and run google/translategemma-4b-it as a full vision-language model (VLM) with ONNX Runtime GenAI. TranslateGemma is a translation model supporting 55 languages, with both text-to-text and image-to-text translation capabilities. This recipe exports it as three separate ONNX sub-models (text decoder, vision encoder, embedding) that run together through the ORT GenAI multimodal pipeline.
